Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the structural analysis of GPI (glycosylphosphatidylinositol) anchors on the protein CD59. While the PRIDE metadata lists 'acetylated residue' in identifiedPTMStrings, the text describes this as a structural analysis of glycoforms. The acquisition mode is DDA (automatic switching between MS and MS/MS). The enrichment is a specific affinity purification of a GPI-anchored protein followed by PI-PLC cleavage to isolate the GPI-peptide moiety.

scope: HFGF-CD59 was liberated from the cell surface by phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C (PI-PLC), affinity-purified and analyzed.
Supernatants were loaded on the columns filled with 0.25 mL of Glutathione Sepharose 4B (GE healthcare) at 4 °C. After washing with 5 mL PBS, HFGF-CD59 was eluted by 5 mL elution-buffer A

While the broader paper describes a CRISPR screen and various other perturbations (ERAD, UGCG), the MS-analyzed samples are limited to these specific genetic comparisons.
